title: Tenant Host Identity Resolution Semantic Contract
description: Draft semantic contract for resolving request host identity to tenant context before authentication callback and session handling.
aiGuidance: Host identity resolution is a semantic prerequisite for tenant-scoped authentication. Do not treat custom-domain source evidence as live-provider login proof.

stateModel.description: Host resolution state covers platform host, active custom tenant host, inactive custom host, and unknown host fail-closed outcome.

permissions.description: Host resolution happens before authenticated user permissions exist; it produces tenant context rather than authorizing user action.

validation.description: Custom host origin must select the correct tenant realm and callback URL without treating mock or local proof as live IdP readiness.

errorModel.description: Unknown, inactive, or disabled host identity fails closed and must not create an authenticated tenant context.

auditModel.description: Detailed host-resolution audit semantics are deferred to later identity-access audit expansion.

uiSemanticDefinition.description: Host identity resolution is request-context semantics, not a direct UI surface in the first slice.
